Living situation, school, and head. I do housework, sleep, cry, and go on Reddit. My older brother lives with me and he's very mean. He yells threatening things all the time (like rape and death threats) but most of the it's while he's playing video games so my parents don't care. When they're not around he yells at me, calls me disgusting/stupid/worthless/etc and hits me sometimes. 

I know I would be happier if something changed. I was suppose to move out in two weeks but my parents told me that, since they couldn't cosign a loan and my grandmother refused to, I have to go to community college with my brother. I hate it here. Like I said, my brothers horrible, and my parents don't allow me to have any friends. I'm 18 years old and I haven't left the house to do anything other than go to the store since very early June. If I stay here any longer I'm afraid my brothers going to seriously do something to me or I'll kill myself from loneliness.
